title: Twins and assisted reproduction family
goal: A reader can identify both twin types, an assisted-reproduction child, and a deceased family member in one pedigree.

rubric.must: Three aligned generation rows are visibly labeled I, II, and III.
III-1 and III-2 form a twin pair whose two child lines meet at one point and are joined by the monozygotic twin bar.
III-3 and III-4 descend from a single shared point on the sibship line with NO horizontal bar between their lines, which is what marks them dizygotic rather than monozygotic.
III-5 has a readable IVF donor-sperm child label and remains connected to the generation-II parents.
The assisted-reproduction label is visually separate from the twin-pair labels and does not obscure a symbol or descent line.
I-1 has a single diagonal deceased slash through the square.
The two twin pairs are visually distinct from each other and from III-5, with no connector ambiguity.

ideal.notes: One sibship line carries monozygotic twins joined at a point with a connecting bar, dizygotic twins joined at a point without one, and the diamond IVF donor-sperm child III-5 marked as proband, below deceased I-1.
